basic_details.job_title: NLU Jodhpur Research Associate Recruitment 2026 – Apply Online
basic_details.short_information: National Law University Jodhpur (NLU Jodhpur) has notified 1 vacancy for the Research Associate post on a contractual basis for a duration of two months, which, if extended, will not be more than three months. Candidates applying for the post must possess an LLM in Law or allied subjects with a minimum of 55% in marks. The offered stipend is Rs. 40,000 per month, subject to the completion of the work. Eligible applicants can apply by email by submitting a single PDF including a cover letter, updated CV and writing sample on or before 31 October 2026.

important_dates.selected candidates informed: Within 2 weeks from the last date to apply

how_to_apply: To apply for the NLU Jodhpur Research Associate post, send one email by October 31, 2026. Follow these steps:
Combine the cover letter, updated CV and writing sample into a single PDF.
Write this subject line: Application: (Research Associate) - Research Project 2026-2027
Attach the single PDF and send the email on or before October 31, 2026.
Writing sample (No requirement of formal publication)
important_instructions: The positions are contractual. NLU Jodhpur reserves the right to accept or reject applications without giving reasons. Selected candidates will be informed within 2 weeks from the last date to apply. The work is remote, but you may have to be present in person if required. The university contact details printed on the notice page are: NH-62, Nagour Road, Mandore, Jodhpur - 342304 (Raj.) - INDIA; email [email protected]; phone +91-291-2577530, 2577526.

content_sections.heading: NLU Jodhpur Research Associate at a Glance
content_sections.text: Register for Job Alerts The Centre for Family Law at NLU Jodhpur is running a study of how Family Courts in Rajasthan work in practice. The project is based on fieldwork in Jaipur, Jodhpur and Alwar. It looks at court infrastructure, delays and counselling support, and aims to recommend practical legal and policy reforms.

rows.details: “Assessing the Efficacy of Family Courts: A Case Study from Rajasthan”
Two months (if extended, not more than 3 months); contractual
₹40,000/- per month (subject to the completion of the work)
Remote (subject to physical presence if required)

content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: The NLU Jodhpur Research Associate notice lists these qualifications: LLM in Law or allied subjects with a minimum of 55% in marks Strong research skills (qualitative analysis, NVivo preferred) Excellent academic writing (publications preferred) Prior engagement in a Research Project is preferred The notice marks three things as preferred: knowledge of NVivo, publications, and earlier work on a research project.
